text:
Yes. According to the current evidence (EU-FIRE-27, version 2, as of 2026-11-12), all four sensors (VIIRS S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21 and MODIS) covered every day from 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-08. NASA FIRMS found no thermal detections intersecting the property in that period.

An earlier version (version 1, as of 2026-10-08) had a gap. It lacked coverage for 2026-10-07 to 2026-10-08 because the near-real-time data had not yet been updated. Version 2 supersedes it and closes that gap.

Caveats: this doesn't prove that no fire occurred, since small, short, cool or cloud-obscured fires can go undetected. It also says nothing about burned area, the cause of any change, or dates outside the period.
